Coram : DIPAK MISRA*, D.Y. CHANDRACHUD, A.M. KHANWILKAR
Motor Vehicles – Motor Accident Claim – 20 year old son of appellant died in an accident – Claims Tribunal (MACT) adopted income of the deceased to be Rs.6,000/-p.m – It applied a multiplier of 11 on the basis of the age of the parents of the of Rs.4,31,000/- – High Court declined to interfere with the award of the Tribunal – On appeal, held: Tribunal gave cogent reasons for declining claim of the appellant that deceased was earning Rs.15,000/- per month – Correct multiplier would be 17 based on the age of the
Decision Date : 19-01-2018 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 448/2018 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 3 Judges
